executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $217.59 per resident day (49.0% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $3,638,558 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 11,755 Medicaid days, $309.53 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $324.72 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $321.83 for July 2025 to June 2026.

Cost year 2025: DSS's review removed $94,320 of the $256,907 management fee (page 16, line m12), leaving $162,587 in the costs DSS counts. The data shows the change, not the reason; DSS caps management fees and can remove related-party charges.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -4.0% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $450,041, 10.0% of the $4,494,382 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $627,531, $30.38 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $366,015 (58.3%), allocated fringe $86,803 (13.8%), non-wage costs $174,713 (27.8%). Raw food was $147,135 ($7.12 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Missing data: cost year 2017 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 11 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $193,605 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Occupational Therapists (page 10 line A12g), removed $95,448; Administrative Management Services (page 16 line m12), removed $94,320; Equipment Lease (page 22 line 6e), removed $47,662. Separately, the home itself removed $482,705 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
